summary: Woori Financial Group filed a Form 6-K announcing the termination of its trust agreement to acquire treasury shares, originally entered on February 10, 2026, after the contract period expired on June 10, 2026. The total contract amount was KRW 200,000,000,000 (approx. $154M). The trust held 5,986,638 common shares (0.82%) plus 53,945 other shares. No separate board resolution was required under Korean law. Treasury shares will be delivered to the corporate account and subsequently cancelled. The expected holding period before cancellation is less than one month. This is a routine expiration of a share-repurchase trust, not a new event. The filing is a foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16. Watch for completion of share cancellation and any impact on EPS.
